content: Komparasaun kona ba ema nebee servisu iha toos uvas nian
“Maromak ukun nudar Liurai, nee hanesan komparasaun tuir mai: Iha toos nain ida, dadeer-saan deit nia baa iha merkadu hodi buka ema atu servisu iha nia toos uvas nian.
Hetan tiha ema, nia konkorda malu ho sira atu selu loron ida osan mutin ida, i nia haruka sira baa servisu kedas iha nia toos.
Tuku sia dadeer, toos nain baa fali merkadu, nia haree tan ema balu hamriik hela, la halo buat ida.
Nia hatete ba sira, ‘Imi baa servisu iha hau nia toos, hau sei selu imi ho lo-loos.’
I sira mos baa. Tuku sanulu resin rua, toos nain sai baa bolu tan ema seluk. Nunee mos tuku tolu lokraik.
Tuku lima mos, nia baa merkadu, hetan ema seluk tan nebee hamriik hela deit. Nia husu sira, ‘Nusaa mak loron tomak imi hamriik iha nee deit, la halo buat ida?’
Sira hataan, ‘La iha ema ida mak foo servisu mai ami.’ Toos nain dehan, ‘Se nunee, imi baa servisu iha hau nia toos deit.’

Rai besik kalan ona, nia hatete ba mandor dehan, ‘Baa bolu ema sira nebee mak servisu iha toos hodi selu sira ida-ida. Maibee selu uluk ema sira nebee mak tama ikus. Sira nebee mak tama uluk, selu ikus.’
Nunee mandor bolu uluk ema nebee mak mai servisu iha tuku lima lokraik, i sira ida-ida simu osan mutin ida.
Entaun ema sira nebee mak mai servisu husi dadeer-saan hanoin katak sira atu simu barak liu fali. Afinal sira mos simu osan mutin ida.
Bainhira sira simu hotu sira nia osan, ema nebee mak tama servisu husi dadeer nee mai murmura ba toos nain
dehan, ‘Sira nebee mai ikus servisu oras ida deit. Nusaa mak sira simu osan hanesan fali ho ami? Ami nee servisu mate aan husi dadeer too lokraik, loron manas mos ami servisu nafatin.’
Rona nunee, toos nain nee hataan ba ema ida husi sira dehan, ‘Belun, hau la halo sala hasoru o. Ita konkorda malu tiha ona katak, o atu simu osan mutin ida iha loron ida, loos ka lae?
Foti o nia osan nee hodi fila ona. Hau hakarak atu ema nebee tama servisu ikus mos simu osan hanesan ho imi.
Nee hau nia osan. Hau iha direitu atu uza tuir hau nia hakarak. Keta halo be o laran moras ba hau tanba hau halo buat diak ba ema seluk.’ ”
Jesus taka Nia liafuan dehan, “Nunee mos ema nebee mak ikus aban-bainrua sai fali primeiru. I ema nebee mak primeiru sai fali ikus.”
Nai Jesus koalia ba dala tolu kona ba Nia mate
Jesus lao dadauk ba sidade Jerusalém, Nia halibur Nia eskolante nain sanulu resin rua hamutuk hodi koalia ba sira deit dehan,

“Rona mai! Ita lao dadauk ba Jerusalém. Too iha nebaa, ema sei entrega Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan ba iha nai lulik nia ulun sira ho mestri relijiaun sira. Ema sira nee sei tesi Hau nia lia katak, Hau tenki hetan kastigu mate.
Sira sei entrega Hau ba iha ema nebee la fiar Maromak. I ema sira nee sei tarata Hau, baku Hau ho sikoti, i prega Hau iha krus. Maibee iha loron tolu Maromak sei halo Hau moris fali husi mate.”
Tiago ho João nia inan husu atu sira sai ema boot
Depois Zebedeu nia feen mai hamutuk ho nia oan Tiago ho João. Senhora nee mai hakneak iha Jesus nia oin hodi husu atu Jesus foo buat ruma ba nia.

Jesus husu, “Senhora hakarak saida?” Senhora nee hataan, “Hau husu atu aban-bainrua kuandu Ita Boot ukun nudar Liurai, hau nia oan nain rua nee, ida tuur iha Ita Boot nia sorin loos, ida iha sorin karuk.”
Maibee Jesus hatete ba Tiago ho João dehan, “Imi la kompriende saida mak imi husu. La kleur tan Hau sei simu terus todan. Imi mos prontu simu terus nee ka lae?”
Sira hataan, “Ami prontu.”

Jesus hatete ba sira, “Loos duni, imi sei simu duni terus hanesan Hau. Maibee Hau la iha direitu atu hili see mak atu tuur iha Hau nia sorin loos ho sorin karuk. Kona ba ida nee, Hau nia Aman iha lalehan desidi tiha ona.”
Bainhira eskolante nain sanulu rona buat nebee mak Tiago ho João husu, sira hirus maun-alin nain rua nee.
Entaun, Jesus bolu sira hamutuk hodi dehan, “Imi hatene katak, iha nasaun sel-seluk, nai ulun sira manda ema tuun-sae, i ukun nain sira hanehan sira nia povu.
Maibee imi la bele halo hanesan nee. Husi imi sira nee, see mak hakarak sai boot, nia tenki haraik aan hodi serbi nia maluk sira seluk.
See mak hakarak sai ema boot liu, nia tenki sai atan ba nia maluk sira seluk hodi serbi sira.
Nia tenki hanesan Hau, Ema Umanu nia Oan. Hau mai iha mundu nee laos atu ema serbi Hau. Maibee Hau mai atu serbi ema seluk i foo Aan ba mate atu ema barak hetan liberdade.”
Nai Jesus kura ema matan delek nain rua
Depois Jesus ho nia eskolante sira sai husi sidade Jerikó, i ema lubun boot mos tuir Nia.
Iha nebaa iha ema matan delek nain rua tuur hela iha dalan ninin. Bainhira sira rona katak Jesus mak liu, sira bolu ho lian makaas dehan, “Nai, liurai David nia Jerasaun, hanoin ami ba!”
Ema lubun boot nee siak sira nain rua hodi haruka sira nonook. Maibee sira nain rua bolu makaas liu tan dehan, “Nai, liurai David nia Jerasaun, hanoin ami ba!”
Rona nunee, Jesus mos para, i Nia bolu sira mai hodi husu, “Imi hakarak Hau halo saida ba imi?”
Sira hataan, “Nai, ami hakarak haree.”
Rona nunee, Jesus hanoin sira nain rua. Nia tau liman ba sira nia matan, i sira haree kedas. Depois sira tuir Jesus.

footnotes.text: Tradusaun literal dehan, “Imi bele hemu husi kopu nebee Hau atu hemu ka?” Iha Biblia, “hemu husi kopu” dala barak signifika hetan terus.
